# Bevory
> Bevory is a city-aware beverage discovery and local price guide for adults aged 25 and older in India. Bevory does not sell alcohol.

## Core pages
- [Local price guide](https://bevory.in/gurgaon): Browse products with approved local price records.
- [Delhi prices](https://bevory.in/delhi): Reviewed bottle prices available in Delhi.
- [Gurgaon prices](https://bevory.in/gurgaon): Reviewed bottle prices available in Gurgaon.
- [Faridabad prices](https://bevory.in/faridabad): Reviewed bottle prices available in Faridabad.
- [Goa prices](https://bevory.in/goa): Reviewed bottle prices available in Goa.
- [Bangalore prices](https://bevory.in/bangalore): Reviewed bottle prices available in Bangalore.
- [Categories](https://bevory.in/categories): Explore beverages by category and subcategory.
- [Brands](https://bevory.in/brands): Browse brand and product pages.
- [Bevory Guide](https://bevory.in/guide): Read beverage education, tasting and responsible-serving articles.
- [Party Planner](https://bevory.in/party-planner): Estimate drinks for a guest count and budget.

## Catalogue rules
- Product variants are shown only when a positive, available price exists for the selected city and the record is not awaiting review.
- Prices are informational and can differ from current retailer prices.
- Canonical product pages use /{city}/product/{product-slug}; exact reviewed bottle-size pages use /{city}/product/{product-slug}/{size}.
- City brand and category pages are indexable only where matching reviewed local products exist. Arbitrary filters, search results and empty price pages are not indexable landing pages.
- [XML sitemap](https://bevory.in/sitemap.xml): Canonical city, product, variant, brand, category, guide, cocktail and video URLs.
